2610.05563.title: G-CARB: Graph-Localized Conformal Agent Risk Budget for Compositional Harm
2610.05563.paper_summary: Small language model (SLM) agents need safety controls that track consequences across tool calls with little monitoring overhead. A private read, for example, becomes a leak when a later action sends that data outside the system. We introduce CARB (Conformal Agent Risk Budget), which calibrates when to stop an agent using a ledger of harm incurred before stopping. Under exchangeable episodes, standard conformal risk control bounds this declared loss in expectation over calibration and a future episode. G-CARB selects scorer evidence along observable dependencies from private sources to outgoing actions. The ledger still covers the entire executed history, and computing the gate score requires no additional language-model inference. On AgentDojo replay with two 14B backbones, G-CARB roughly halves scorer-input records at intermediate risk budgets while improving autonomous task completion relative to full-prefix scoring; random context of the same size achieves similar gains. Controlled examples show how retaining the relevant dependency can further avoid stopping benign work.
2610.05563.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型 (SLM) 代理需要安全控制，以便在工具調用中追踪後果，並且監控開銷很小。舉例來說，當後續行動將數據發送到系統外部時，私有讀取就會變成洩漏。我們引入了 CARB（符合性代理風險預算），它通過在停止之前記錄所造成的損害來校準何時停止代理。在可交換的情境下，標準的符合性風險控制將這一宣告損失的期望值限制在校準和未來情境之上。G-CARB 根據可觀察的依賴關係從私有來源到外部行動中選擇評分證據。這個賬本仍然涵蓋整個執行歷史，計算閘門分數不需要額外的語言模型推斷。在 AgentDojo 重播中，使用兩個 14B 的骨幹，G-CARB 大約將中間風險預算下的評分輸入記錄減半，同時相對於全前綴評分改善自主任務的完成；相同大小的隨機上下文也達到了類似的增益。受控示例顯示，保留相關依賴關係可以進一步避免停止良性工作。
